title: KramakWorkItem
description: Schema for Kramak autonomous development work item specification

id.description: Unique work item identifier formatted as WI-XXX (e.g. WI-001)

title.description: Concise human/agent-readable title of the work item (max 120 chars)

batch.description: Batch iteration index this work item belongs to

detail_level.description: Specification detail scaling tier: guided (high/red), directed (medium/yellow), outcome (low/green)

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the work item

files_targeted.description: Explicit array of file paths this work item is permitted to modify (immutable after planning)

dependencies.description: Work Item IDs that must reach done status before this item may execute

retry_budget.description: Maximum allowed retry attempts before failing/escalating (default 3, max 5)

attempts.description: Number of execution attempts performed so far

acceptance_criteria.description: Deterministic testable criteria that must pass for work item verification

category.description: Repair-oriented diagnostic category per Kramak failure taxonomy

description.description: Detailed explanation of the failure root cause

error_trajectory.description: Chronological history of error outputs across failed attempts

failure_diagnosis.description: Diagnostic record if the work item has failed

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item was generated

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item reached terminal done/failed status, or null

verification_commands.description: Optional CLI verification and test commands to validate acceptance criteria
